title: The Heliosphere
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Solar physicist Dr. Mariam Okoye discovers a shadow crossing the heliosphere — a dark patch on the sunward data that moves against the solar wind. It is not a storm. It is not a craft. It is a question, and it is aimed at Earth.
